rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when a method, action, or event produces a result.
Use this when someone gives in to an enemy or opposing force rather than continuing to resist.

example.english: The enemy surrounded the whole city, and the defenders finally had to yield.
example.traditional: 敵軍包圍咗成個城，守軍最後唯有投降。
example.jyutping: dik6 gwan1 baau1 wai4 zo2 seng4 go3 sing4 sau2 gwan1 zeoi3 hau6 wai4 jau5 tau4 hong4

rows.note: Use this when giving way so another person or vehicle can pass first.

example.english: The car ahead has stopped, so we have to yield to the ambulance first.
example.traditional: 前面架車停低咗，我哋要讓路畀救護車先。
example.jyutping: cin4 min6 gaa3 ce1 ting4 dai1 zo2 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 joeng6 lou6 bei2 gau3 wu6 ce1 sin1
